celebrationLangHint: Controls the language of every celebration card (titles, numbers, names, and page direction) on all screens, even if a screen itself is set to another language. An advisor or team name shows in Arabic only if its Arabic name is filled in.
settingsHint: Applies to every screen: automatic deal celebrations and manual shout-outs.
noSongsYet: Upload a song in the sound library first.
settingsSaved: Saved — screens use the new settings from the next celebration.
libraryHint: Songs for celebrations and short clips for messages. MP3, M4A or WAV, up to {mb} MB each.
notAudio: The file must be audio (MP3, M4A, WAV or OGG).
tooBig: The file is larger than {mb} MB.
confirmDelete: Delete “{name}” permanently? Celebrations and messages using it will play without sound.
hideAgentSalesHint: Screens hide each agent's amount (agent ranking, top-performer card, latest deals and notifications). Team totals and targets stay visible.
hideMarketsHint: The markets screen (gold, dollar, stocks) leaves the automatic rotation.
hideInsightsHint: The insights screen leaves the automatic rotation and the header view buttons.
